name: Northpass Tower
summary: Northpass Tower is a ruined Lordaeron scout tower situated in the northern reaches of the Eastern Plaguelands along the road to the Ghostlands. Shattered during the Third War, its vantage point makes it a critical strategic prize in the escalating conflict between the Alliance and the Horde.

sections.title: Northern Sentinel
sections.body: Built by the Kingdom of Lordaeron to guard the vital thoroughfare leading north into Quel'Thalas, Northpass Tower was reduced to a broken shell during the Scourge invasion. Despite its shattered stonework, the tower's elevated position retains immense tactical value, overlooking the blight-choked frontier between Stratholme's blighted outskirts and the distant elven lands.

sections.title: Frontline Contention
sections.body: With the Argent Dawn entrenched at Light's Hope Chapel, both the Alliance and the Horde seek to establish defensible outposts across the Plaguelands. Northpass Tower has become a frequent flashpoint, as securing its remnants bolsters regional supply lines and provides a forward foothold against both opposing factions and encroaching Scourge patrols.

faq.q: What was Northpass Tower originally built for?
faq.answer: It was originally erected as an observation post by the Kingdom of Lordaeron to monitor the northern road leading toward the elven kingdom of Quel'Thalas.

faq.q: Why is Northpass Tower in ruins?
faq.answer: It was destroyed alongside the rest of Lordaeron's northern defenses during the Scourge invasion in the Third War, leaving behind only cracked masonry and scaffolding.

faq.q: Why do the Alliance and Horde fight over this tower?
faq.answer: Both factions are pushing into the Plaguelands to counter the Scourge and each other. Holding Northpass Tower provides a fortified scout outpost and vital regional influence along the northern roads.

faq.q: Where does the road past Northpass Tower lead?
faq.answer: The road heads north directly toward the Thalassian border and the Ghostlands, the southern territory of Quel'Thalas.

angles.text: Reclaiming Northpass Tower represents a vital step toward restoring Lordaeron's fallen bastions and denying the Horde a staging ground in the north.
Securing this strategic ruin protects northern movements and fortifies the Horde's offensive against the Scourge and Alliance interlopers alike.
